verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents first-party webhooks delivered to an endpoint you host [marqeta-docs-9, marqeta-docs-20]. It also treats reversals as distinct transaction event types [marqeta-docs-10, marqeta-docs-19], offers transaction retrieval endpoints [marqeta-docs-7], and has a dispute /cases API [marqeta-docs-22]. That shows the programmatic foundation for post-auth handling, but nothing confirms which post-auth events are pushed as webhooks. Missing for 10: explicit webhook event types for clearing, refund, reversal and chargeback; documented stable transaction identifiers linking auth to post-auth events; any reconciliation or ledger-drift guidance; independent or hands-on corroboration.
